_doc.amount: multiplier on all distortion coefficients (1 = measured lens)
_doc.breathing: multiplier on the focus-dependent part (0 = none, 1 = measured, 2 = exaggerated)
_doc.out_of_range: Clamp | Extrapolate: behaviour outside the profile's measured focal range
_doc.wide_boost: extra barrel below below_mm, full at full_mm (k1 negative = more barrel)
_doc.vignette: mode Physical (cos^4 + barrel clipping from lens specs; natural_falloff 0..1, mechanical_strength) or Manual (curves)
_doc.bokeh: mode Physical (blades/barrel from lens specs; cats_eye_strength) or Manual; petzval swirl is always manual (0 for real modern primes)
_doc.note: imported by Content/Python/dynamiclens_tools.import_presets(); physical specs live in profile_specs

ARRI_Master.source: ARRI/Zeiss Master Prime data sheet: 114 mm front, T1.3, 9-blade iris. Distortion from Andy Davis (Imagery for Media) lens files, Alexa SXT / Mini.

ZEISS_Supreme.source: Zeiss Supreme Prime data sheet: 95 mm front, T1.5. Blade count from Andy Davis's camera ini. Distortion from Andy Davis lens files.

Master.label: ARRI/Zeiss Master Prime, as measured. Physical vignette and cat's eye, no swirl.

Supreme.label: Zeiss Supreme Prime, as measured. Physical vignette and cat's eye, no swirl.

MasterHeavy.label: Master Prime x1.8 with fisheye under 24 mm and strong breathing (The Favourite vibe). Extrapolates below 12 mm.

Subtle.label: Supreme x0.5, no breathing, light vignette, clean modern look.

Vintage.label: Master profile with a mild Petzval swirl, stronger cat's eye and vignette.
